name: sync-dev-deployment
description: Sync application dev environment deployment scripts

scripts.docker:build:fallback: npm run build:local && cp Dockerfile.fallback Dockerfile && npm run docker:build && cp Dockerfile.fallback.bak Dockerfile
scripts.docker:restart: npm run docker:down && npm run docker:up
scripts.docker:deploy: npm run docker:down && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up
scripts.docker:deploy:fallback: npm run docker:down && npm run docker:build:fallback && npm run docker:up
scripts.docker:redeploy: echo 'Starting redeploy...' && npm run docker:stop && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up && echo 'Redeploy completed!'
scripts.docker:clean:all: npm run docker:clean && docker system prune -f
scripts.health:check: curl -f http://localhost:8061/actuator/health || echo 'Application not ready yet'
scripts.db:init: docker-compose -f docker-compose-dev.yml exec sync-test-mysql mysql -u root -p123456 sync_test < /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-schema.sql
scripts.help: echo 'Available commands: deploy, docker:stop, docker:redeploy, docker:build, docker:up, docker:down, docker:restart, docker:logs, docker:status, docker:clean, health:check, docker:deploy:fallback'

author: Development Team
